found.name: Introduction to Microsoft Copilot
found.quote: We have developed two main resources to support you in introducing you to GenAI and developing your skills and competencies in using GenAI. Firstly, Introduction to Microsoft Copilot introduces you to Microsoft Copilot, what it can do and strategies for using it effectively and ethically.

found.name: Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) Module
found.quote: Secondly, the Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) Module is designed to equip you with essential GenAI skills tailored for academic contexts, while also fostering a deep understanding of AI literacy and the crucial role of critical thinking in this rapidly changing domain.
